formal_methodological_clarifications.thinning_independence: Thinning does NOT establish independent draws unless the thinning interval k >> 2 * tau_int. With parameter tau_int between 13.1 and 26.6, 10x thinning leaves significant autocorrelation (rho_10 in [0.46, 0.68]). For EUR samples, stride Delta_k = 53.3 > 2 * max(tau_int) ensures tau_int = 1.00 and N_eff = 150.
formal_methodological_clarifications.bayesian_conditionality: All posterior probabilities are strictly conditional on the assumed Gaussian likelihood function, uniform prior over geological bounds, GP emulator approximation, and frozen forecasting architecture (Blend_Phase_Specific_Simplex).
formal_methodological_clarifications.prms_reserves_distinction: Technical EUR conditional quantiles from this surrogate model are technical production forecasts of recoverable hydrocarbons. They do NOT constitute PRMS commercial 1P/2P/3P reserves, which additionally require project economic sanction, commerciality, facility processing capacities, economic limit cuts, and legal entitlements.
